# neo3ds

> neo3ds turns Neo Geo (MAME) romsets into installable Nintendo 3DS CIAs and runs them
> on real hardware — including the original Old 3DS — at 60 fps, one HOME menu icon per
> game. 242 of the 282 romsets in its game database convert; 25 are confirmed on real
> hardware. The converter runs offline (Windows, Linux, macOS) and in the browser.

## Pages

- [Intro](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/): what neo3ds is, the three-step set-up, and a compatibility summary.
- [Compatibility list](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/compat.html): every one of the 282 romsets with its conversion status, generated from the game database.
- [Web converter](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/convert.html): converts a romset zip to a CIA inside the browser tab. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed.
- [3DS manual](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/manual.html): launcher, controls, key configuration, and how to install a CIA with FBI.
- [Changelog](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/changelog.html): every release, newest first.
- [Korean site](https://zzcx88.github.io/neo3ds/ko/): the same pages in Korean.

## Facts

- Requirements: a Neo Geo romset zip (MAME set names) plus `neogeo.zip` for encrypted carts.
- Output: one CIA per game, installed with FBI on the 3DS.
- Conversion is done locally. The browser converter uses WebAssembly in a worker and never uploads the rom.
- The engine targets Old 3DS, New 3DS, 2DS and 3DS XL.
- Source: https://github.com/zzcx88/neo3ds
